title: M1 Config, scope & safety core
description: Config loading from ~/.brooom, repo detection, workspace discovery, root/symlink validation with path-escape tests on all OSes, parallel walker and scan cache.

title: M2 Findings output & scan engine
description: Scan command wiring, all output formats (table, tree, json, ndjson, plain, summary), NO_COLOR/TTY handling, --quiet, findings schema docs.

title: M3 Git detectors & actions
description: stale-branch, merged-branch (ancestor + squash), worktrees detectors; delete-branch, remove-worktree, prune-worktrees actions; action executor with dry-run/confirm/apply.

title: M4 Trash, sessions & undo
description: OS trash for Windows/macOS/Linux, quarantine and delete strategies, session manifests, undo, sessions, purge.

title: M5 AI artifacts & log detectors
description: Embedded tool-location catalog, ai-artifacts detector (project and user-level), log-and-runtime-files detector with open-file detection.

title: M6 Build artifacts & git bloat
description: build-artifacts detector weighted by project inactivity, large-untracked detector, git-bloat detector and git purge actions.

title: M7 Sweep, completions & release
description: sweep presets, clean --from, roots/config commands, shell completions, update-check, GoReleaser pipeline, GitHub releases, package manager manifests (publishing disabled).

title: M8 Landing page
description: Astro site with Vue islands in /site, deployed to GitHub Pages.

title: M9 Hardening
description: End-to-end tests, cross-platform edge cases, performance on large workspaces, documentation polish found by orchestration reviews.
